{{Top|leg}}
An Imperial '''slave world''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] kept an occupying force on and drew from the local population of when seeking [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] laborers for Imperial construction projects. [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] was one such world.<ref name="Rebel Dawn">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref>
